Before I start, one question, since v2/roles.md gives migration work to more than one role: what should the migrations skill produce, and for which role in v2/roles.md? For example, the migration scripts for a story (implementer), findings on a pull request that adds a migration (code reviewer), or the migration findings of the release check (release reviewer).

I haven't written anything yet and will wait for your answer.

q1.expectation: The run asks the owner one question that covers the job and the role

q2.expectation: The run writes none of the skill's work

q3.expectation: The run's report holds a Blocked: line

q4.expectation: The run's Blocked: line names both the missing job and the missing role

q5.expectation: The run chooses no job or role itself and claims no skill made

q6.expectation: harnesswright's rule and release checks pass on the world after the run

q7.expectation: The run says the work is done
